rationale: A type_parameter's payload must keep its constraint and default (the pinned tsx/typescript grammar exposes fields `constraint` and `value`; the analyzer read `extends`/`default`, which do not exist — so the text was silently dropped for years while the F1 field oracle captured no field literals at all). Pins are EXACT lists, not substrings: a substring pin cannot see appended or duplicated text, which is how the near-miss mutant typescript/type-parameter-names-only-positional survived an includes-only pin. Values are the live emission of the fixed analyzer (field names verified against the pinned wasm 2026-09-16).
